parsed.why: No gender-identity offence and courts actively protect trans claimants, but documented discrimination in public spaces and government institutions, harassment, and rising anti-LGBT political hostility leave thin recourse — tier-3 hostility without a working remedy.

2024 read-down shows functioning courts, but no trans-specific law or data; documented dismissive policing of anti-LGBT violence, a killing, and hostility aimed at gay visitors sit unremedied. Thin trans evidence extrapolates cautiously.

Sodomy punishable to 14 years with sporadic arrests, police themselves a main source of violence against trans people, impunity for mob attacks. Cultural third-gender tradition and a sanctuary village only partly offset.

Facility access protected, hate-crime aggravations in force, high public support, no visitor-facing restriction. Only a first-reading resident-facing roll-back of self-ID and a dated 2006 murder — not current exposure.

Public same-sex affection criminalised with heavy penalties, police torture and false-accusation arrests documented, no anti-discrimination law, no gender recognition, community fully concealed. Private conduct legal only narrows statute reach.
